messages:
Asha (CS): quick async standup — three quick items: 1) Greenbridge renewal is next Tue, want to confirm we've shipped the slow-webhook mitigation; 2) Kestrel adoption customers seeing webhook retry storms overnight (spike ~4x); 3) small CR to adjust dead-letter routing needs a second engineer review before I push the plan to the customer.

Priya (CS Ops): pinging on Greenbridge — they asked for a timeline this morning, said legal wants the SLA confirmation by EOD Fri. :alarm_clock:

Mason (Eng): saw the retry spikes in the dashboard, digging in. initial hunch is that some 5xxs from partner endpoints are not being deduped by our backoff logic, so retries pile up. I'll run an experiment to increase jitter on the exponential backoff and push a config toggle. :mag_right:

Diego (SRE): thanks Mason — can you include a short runbook blurb for incident ops? if retries cascade they can exhaust connection slots for dedicated pools. also want to watch per-customer socket usage during the test.

Asha (CS): for the CR: it's small — change routing so requests that hit partner-503 for >3 attempts go to DLQ after 2s jitter, plus emit metric cs.webhook.too_many_retries. needs 1 reviewer before we tell Greenbridge. tagging @Mason for code review and @Diego for SRE signoff.

Mason (Eng): ok I can review tonight. can you paste the CR link? also if anyone has a quick test customer id I can replay the spikes locally.

Priya (CS Ops): test id: cust_kestrel_42 — we replayed their webhook logs in staging last night.

Mason (Eng): perfect. quick log snippet from staging showing the pattern: 
```
2026-03-15T23:48:02Z req=abc123 status=503 retries=1
2026-03-15T23:48:05Z req=abc123 status=503 retries=2
2026-03-15T23:48:08Z req=abc123 status=503 retries=3
2026-03-15T23:48:09Z queue_depth=78
```
This is the dup/retry loop. CR will add jitter + DLQ threshold + metric.

Diego (SRE): sounds good. suggest also a short-lived feature flag so we can roll back if it increases latencies for other customers. I can add the flag to the runtime config.

Asha (CS): agree on flag. Greenbridge wants to see the plan doc and the rollback clause. Priya can share the draft with them once we have an ETA.

Mason (Eng): planning to open the PR by 18:00 PT, will paste link here. Can someone from CS confirm the wording for the rollback clause? small bullet: "if DB connection errors or increased 95th p99 token latency >200ms for 3 consecutive minutes, revert to previous retry behavior" — is that sensible?

Priya (CS Ops): that sounds clear. I'll add it and set expectation with Greenbridge that we'll aim for Wed deploy to staging, Thu validation, Fri decision for prod.

Asha (CS): blocker for me: need legal to ok the SLA language; Priya is on it. otherwise no other blockers. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

cs-bot: deploy scheduled: staging feature-flag-create at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z UTC (will notify if rollout fails).
